name: codebase-design
title_zh: 把模块接口设计成深模块的共享词汇表
tagline_zh: 当你想划清接口边界、找深化机会、让代码更可测或更易被 AI 导航时，这套词汇让讨论不再各说各话。
tagline_en: When you're drawing seams, deepening interfaces, or making code testable and AI-navigable, this shared vocabulary.
desc_en: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules. Use when the user wants to design or improve a module's interface, find deepening opportunities, decide where a seam goes, make code more testable or AI-navigable, or when another skill needs the deep-module vocabulary.
why_zh: 它不给你答案，而是给设计讨论一套共同语言——让「深模块」「接缝」这类概念可指认、可复用，避免空泛争论。
why_en: It doesn't hand you answers—it hands you a shared language for design debates, so terms like 'deep module' and 'seam' become.
limit_zh: 只提供词汇和判断框架，不产出具体代码或架构图。若你已明确知道接口怎么改，或团队没有设计讨论场景，它只会增加一层抽象。
limit_en: Vocabulary only, no code or diagrams. If the interface change is already obvious, or no one's debating design, it adds abstraction without payoff.
